row.body: The party route sheet lists every block as cleared, but a resident’s key is still held at the check-in table.
row.title: Block party route

sidecar.gloss: A block is marked clear while a resident’s key remains.
sidecar.rival_reading: A volunteer may have collected keys for ordinary street access; the sheet does not show who cleared the blocks.

row.body: matching white stripes cross the stapler and first-aid kit. a name-sized patch on the stapler has been scrubbed bare.
row.title: missing count beside the stapler

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
